label: Tertiary education share
reliability_criteria: Canonical tier = Eurostat edat_lfse_03 pinned isced11=ED5-8 (tertiary as highest attainment), age=Y25-64 (the LFS's adult band), sex=T, unit=PC (the dataset's only unit, pinned and guarded): 36 countries (EU + EFTA + the Balkans + Türkiye; no XK), the door's own per-country starts (Belgium/Denmark/Germany/Greece/ Ireland 1992, France 1993 — the attainment series reach deeper than the probe's pinned window), the collector's b/e/p flags transported as-reported. Witness tier = the Barro-Lee/Lee-Lee long-run panel via OWID's chart door, 153 entities 1870-2010+, 5-year steps. Root pair eurostat_lfs/ barro_lee: the survey print and the reconciled scholarly panel — on the co-covered core they print the same levels to a few points (the panel's partial-tertiary bucket running above the LFS's completed-only face by construction), the seam documented, never blended.
license: Eurostat reuse policy (attribution required, no endorsement implied); OWID chart data CC-BY-4.0 (source: Barro and Lee (2015); Lee and Lee (2016)) — see docs/licenses.md.
notes: THE EDUCATION COLLECTOR GAP (the v18 probe record, sources.yaml): UNESCO UIS — the questionnaire collector that would be this metric's un_dyb — carries no live machine door in 2026 (the SDMX API decommissioned; the databrowser exposes per-indicator CSV exports with no clean wire). The LFS attainment table is the collector print the pair CAN reach: one questionnaire (the labour-force survey), three Todd metrics (unemployment v17, tertiary and secondary v18). THE ISCED CHOICE: ED5-8 = tertiary as HIGHEST attainment (the completed face); ED3-8 "at least upper secondary", ED34_44/ED35_45 (the survey-variant recodes) and the M/F sex splits are recorded unwired in sources.yaml, one ref away each. Todd's US-cohort BA board (L'illusion) and the 70-74 cohort reads (La Défaite) are panel faces — the witness carries them; the canonical's Y25-64 band is the LFS's own adult window, not a cohort decomposition. The mean-years-of-schooling-long-run chart (the same OWID collection) is deliberately NOT wired — one witness door is the minimal honest choice, the v13 precedent. SECONDARY'S WITNESS GAP (the sibling config's note, recorded here because the pair reads together): the OWID door exposes tertiary and mean-years only — no machine- readable secondary-attainment chart exists (probed 2026-09-21, all candidate slugs 404), so secondary rides canonical-only, the world face waiting on a Barro-Lee direct door (the site is live, the data files are manual downloads — recorded in sources.yaml as the future wiring).
